title: Research 2026-10-21
body: Studied: the engine's 23:20Z pass (31 listed, 0 ordered), bids (680 resting, $207, 1 fill) and held-back reasons. Leak/limit: 21 of 31 bets were held because the other books' prices were too old (an 844 s full scan left the fair 21 min old on median); 7 were over 6 h away. Changed: nothing today, the age limit is a quality guard and the class B evidence is not in. Next: split held-back bets inside 6 h by fair age against their CLV (TASKS XOW6). Engine healthy: live trading, no stand-down, no address refusals.
